meaning: Given a true admitted content at w, forward knowability supplies an R-successor v knowing it. Every E-successor u of w is an R-successor by inclusion; Euclideanness gives R(u,v). Reverse knowability at u then gives truth at u, hence relational knowledge at w. No factivity, reflexivity, epistemic transitivity, Moore closure, classical stability or actuality-index transport is used. This is a conditional consequence under the explicit stronger biconditional, not a proof of its applicability or unrestricted omniscience.
